title: Myte
move_pattern: Myte uses a conditional starting move based on its slot position: first slot begins with Toxic Cornucopia, second slot begins with Suck. Regardless of starting position, the moves cycle: Toxic Cornucopia → Bite → Suck → (repeat). The Suck attack applies Strength to itself, making it progressively more dangerous.
notes: Myte gains Strength each time it uses Suck, making it a threat that increases in power over time. The Toxic Cornucopia attack fills the player's hand with useless cards, forcing discard decisions.
